run_interactive_translation: run the fairseq interactive translation CLI to translate raw text with a trained model
run_buffered_read: run buffered_read to read input lines from a file in fixed-size batches
run_make_batches: run make_batches to encode source strings and yield batched inference data for a fairseq task
run_main: run main to load a model ensemble, build a generator, and perform interactive inference on input text
run_cli_main: run cli_main to parse generation arguments and start the interactive translation pipeline
